jobs.title: Environmental Health Specialist
jobs.description:
**About FACS**

At FACS, our mission is to make environments safer and healthier for the people who live and work in them. As one of the nation's leading environmental health consulting firms, we help organizations protect their people, assets, and communities. We are built on purpose, partnership, and performance, delivering measurable impact with every client engagement.

**Our Values**

We live our mission through three core values:

* **People First:** Support our team and clients, promote professional growth, and value collaboration.
* **Integrity of the Science:** Deliver accurate, reliable results through objective, evidence-based practices.
* **Client Relationships for Life:** Build long-term partnerships and help clients address environmental health challenges.

**Why Join Us**

* **Impact:** Contribute meaningful work that empowers teams and drives results across the organization.
* **Culture:** Thrive in a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven environment where your work matters.
* **Growth:** Innovate, develop your skills, and help shape the future of how we operate and deliver on our mission.
* **Visibility:** Partner directly with leadership and cross-functional teams to make a real difference.

Ranked "Best Places to Work" for five consecutive years, we invest in your success through training, mentorship, and support for professional certifications—so you can grow, thrive, and build a career with lasting impact.

*Curious to see what we do? Meet our team at* FACS Experts.

**About the Role:**

The Environmental Health Specialist will support public health and well-being by conducting fieldwork and environmental assessments for a variety of environmental health and industrial hygiene projects. Under the direction of Project Managers, you will support projects involving asbestos, lead, mold and moisture, indoor environmental quality, air and exposure sampling, and other environmental health concerns.

This is a field-based role that requires regular travel to local client sites and occasional travel outside the local area, depending on project needs. You will collect samples and field data, document site conditions, prepare accurate field notes, and communicate project updates to Project Managers.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on work, takes pride in accuracy and professionalism, and is eager to develop technical experience in environmental health and industrial hygiene. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong attention to detail, reliability, a positive work ethic, and a willingness to learn beyond their current comfort zone.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform assigned fieldwork and project tasks under the direction of Project Managers.
* Travel regularly to local client sites and occasionally to out-of-area locations based on project needs.
* Support environmental health and industrial hygiene projects involving asbestos, lead, mold and moisture, indoor environmental quality, air and exposure sampling, and other environmental health concerns.
* Review project scopes, site requirements, and field protocols to ensure a clear understanding of assigned work.
* Collect field data and samples in accordance with established procedures, project specifications, and safety requirements.
* Conduct site observations and document field conditions accurately and thoroughly.
* Prepare, organize, maintain, and transport the tools, equipment, and supplies needed for assigned fieldwork.
* Maintain detailed field notes; compile data; and summarize findings to support project reporting and analysis.
* Communicate regularly with Project Managers regarding project status, technical questions, field conditions, and next steps.
* Report progress, concerns, and deviations from project scope or established protocols promptly.
* Interact professionally and collaboratively with clients, contractors, building occupants, and other stakeholders at project sites.
* Follow all company safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment.
* Participate actively in training, mentorship, and professional-development opportunities to build technical knowledge in environmental health and industrial hygiene.
* Support the delivery of high-quality, timely client service while maintaining FACS’s standards for accuracy, professionalism, and integrity.

**What You Bring:**

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail.
* Reliable, professional, and able to follow field protocols, safety requirements, and project instructions.
* Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, current auto insurance, and a driving record that meets company standards.
* Ability to travel regularly to local client sites, with occasional out-of-area travel as needed.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of this field-based role, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends based on project requirements.

**Preferred**

* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in a related field.
* Fieldwork or related experience in environmental services, construction, facilities, EHS, restoration, inspection, sampling, or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with asbestos, lead, mold and moisture, indoor environmental quality, or air and exposure sampling

**Physical & Work Requirements**

* Physical ability to stoop, kneel, climb, crawl, walk, and stand for extended periods in varied work environments while performing sampling activities
* Ability to lift and carry equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer for documentation and reporting
* Must be able to pass a background check, annual medical examinations, and OSHA-required respirator fit tests
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and current auto insurance
* Ability to travel locally to assigned client and project sites

jobs.title: Senior Environmental Project Manager, Stormwater & Water Quality
jobs.description:
Short Description:

Bowman has an opportunity for a Senior Environmental Project Manager, Stormwater & Water Quality to join our team in Davis, CA.

At Bowman, we believe in creating opportunities for aspiring people to thrive and achieve ambitious goals. That’s why a career at Bowman is more than a job. It is an opportunity to be part of a diverse and engaged community of professionals, to be treated as a respected and valued member of a motivated team and to be empowered to do exceptional work that advances the best interest of everyone involved. We recognize the importance of creating a work environment that is both rewarding to our employees and supportive of our unwavering commitment to provide unparalleled service to our clients.

Overview:

Provide technical and project management expertise for Bowman's Natural Resources: Permitting and Compliance Team in delivering stormwater regulatory services to public agency, municipal, construction, development, and private-sector clients. This includes MS4 program support, construction and industrial stormwater compliance, and related water quality services. This is a hybrid technical/project management role: the Senior Environmental Project Manager will oversee the technical quality of the team's stormwater work, provide guidance for the development and performance of its staff, and the growth of the practice through client relationships and business development.

The Senior Environmental Project Manager will coordinate with engineers, project managers, scientists, clients, and regulatory agencies to deliver projects on schedule and on budget.

Responsibilities:

**Leadership and Direction**

* Receive broad guidance from senior-level management on key objectives, critical issues, and policy matters, and manage people and processes to ensure effective execution.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team, including goal setting, performance management, and career development.
* Plan and balance team workload and staffing across multiple concurrent projects, and anticipate resource needs as the practice grows.
* Review work produced by staff for technical accuracy, regulatory defensibility, and overall quality.
* Help develop processes and provide input on achieving company and office operational excellence while growing the region and office.

**Business Development and Client Relationships**

* Serve as a senior point of contact for clients, maintaining existing and building new long-term relationships with municipalities, public agencies, and construction and development clients.
* Identify, pursue, and win new work, including prospecting, marketing the firm's stormwater capabilities, and responding to RFPs and RFQs.
* Prepare scopes of work, fee estimates, proposals, contracts, and change orders.
* Collaborate with other Bowman offices and service lines to cross-sell and deliver integrated solutions.
* Drive profitability and growth through sound project and financial management, including tracking budgets, utilization, and revenue goals for the team.

**Technical Leadership and Project Delivery**

* Lead and manage project teams from proposal through project close-out, ensuring work is completed on time and within budget while also performing own project duties.
* Direct stormwater compliance services, including SWPPP development and implementation, construction site monitoring and inspections, BMP design and inspection, qualified precipitation event (QPE) and qualifying storm event (QSE) planning and ERA Level 1 and 2 reporting.
* Provide technical direction and quality review for municipal (MS4) and industrial stormwater programs, including permit enrollment, monitoring programs, and annual and regulatory reports.
* Oversee stormwater sampling, field monitoring, and laboratory data quality assurance.
* Support Clean Water Act Section 401 and 404 permitting, and technical water quality input to CEQA documents.
* Represent clients and the firm in meetings and negotiations with the State Water Resources Control Board, Regional Water Quality Control Boards, and other regulatory agencies.
* Review project changes, anticipated contract alterations, and additional work requests that may affect staffing or budget.

Success Metrics and Competencies:

**Leadership and Business**

* Strong leadership and communication skills, with a proven track record in project management.
* Sound business acumen, including a working understanding of financial reports and metrics and of the business principles of a consulting firm.
* Strong marketing and business development skills and mindset, with a commitment to driving profitability and growth.
* Outstanding client management skills and a commitment to promoting the firm's reputation through quality of work.
* Ability to manage competing demands, establish priorities, and manage multiple time-sensitive projects and project teams.
* Ability to manage, mentor and train junior staff
* Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization and with external partners, including scientists, engineers, surveyors, clients, landowners, government agency personnel, and the general public.
* Flexibility, tact, and excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across offices and facilitate agreement.
* High degree of discretion in managing confidential information.
* Self-reliance and the ability to operate independently with limited direction.
* Commitment to becoming a "citizen" of the broader organization, breaking down barriers and silos, and aspiring to grow and advance within the company.

**Technical**

* In-depth knowledge of California stormwater regulations, including the Clean Water Act, the Porter-Cologne Water Quality Control Act, the Construction General Permit, the Industrial General Permit, and Phase I and II MS4 permits.
* Ability to learn, understand, and apply environmental laws and regulations, agency policies, and permitting requirements, and to translate them into pract

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist (NEC)
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Environmental Scientist will undertake specialised environmental science duties involving the investigation, assessment and monitoring of environmental conditions, including soil, water, land and other natural resources.

The position will contribute to the identification of environmental risks, assessment of potential environmental impacts and development of appropriate management and mitigation strategies.

The successful candidate will work both independently and collaboratively with operational personnel, management, contractors and relevant stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities and Duties

The successful applicant will be responsible for:

* Conducting environmental field investigations, inspections and scientific assessments to identify existing environmental conditions and potential environmental risks.
* Collecting, analysing and interpreting soil, water and other environmental samples to assess contamination, pollution levels and environmental quality.
* Monitoring environmental conditions and evaluating the impacts of operational and project activities on surrounding land, water, ecosystems and natural resources.
* Undertaking environmental assessments and investigations to identify potential impacts associated with construction, civil works, land disturbance and other operational activities.
* Developing, implementing and reviewing environmental management plans, procedures and control measures to minimise adverse environmental impacts.
* Identifying environmental hazards, non-compliance issues and potential risks, and recommending appropriate corrective and preventative actions.
* Providing scientific advice and technical recommendations to management regarding environmental protection, pollution prevention, land management and environmental compliance.
* Preparing detailed environmental assessment reports, technical documentation, monitoring reports and recommendations based on scientific findings and collected data.
* Assessing environmental data, identifying trends and interpreting scientific results to support operational and environmental management decisions.
* Monitoring the effectiveness of environmental control measures and recommending improvements where necessary.
* Assisting with the development and implementation of environmental rehabilitation, remediation and land restoration strategies where required.
* Ensuring environmental activities are conducted in accordance with applicable Western Australian and Commonwealth environmental legislation, regulations, standards and guidelines.
* Liaising with regulatory authorities, environmental consultants, laboratories, contractors and other relevant stakeholders regarding environmental matters.
* Maintaining accurate records of environmental inspections, sampling activities, monitoring results, investigations and corrective actions.
* Providing environmental guidance and technical support to operational personnel to promote environmental awareness and responsible workplace practices.
* Investigating environmental incidents, assessing their potential impacts and recommending appropriate remedial and preventative measures.
* Essential Qualifications

Applicants must possess:

* A Bachelor Degree or higher qualification in Environmental Science, Environmental Studies, Soil Science or another highly relevant environmental science discipline.
* Demonstrated technical knowledge of environmental assessment, scientific investigation and environmental monitoring.
* Strong understanding of soil and water sampling, environmental testing and scientific data analysis.
* Knowledge of relevant environmental legislation, regulatory requirements and environmental management principles.

Essential Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Relevant professional experience in environmental science, environmental investigations or a closely related scientific discipline.
* Experience undertaking environmental fieldwork, inspections and sampling activities.
* Ability to analyse and interpret scientific and environmental data.
* Experience preparing technical reports and environmental documentation.
* Knowledge of environmental risk identification, impact assessment and mitigation strategies.
* Understanding of environmental compliance requirements and environmental management systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and technical report-writing skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple responsibilities.
* Effective communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* A practical approach to identifying environmental issues and developing scientifically supported solutions.

Pay: $79,423.00 – $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Visa sponsorship

Experience:

* Environmental services: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**Come grow with us.**

AECOM's environmental practice is dedicated to helping industries, clients and governments meet their environmental responsibilities while protecting the natural environment. We provide advisory and technical services to ensure compliance, manage impacts, and reduce risks, including obtaining permits and approvals, decommissioning and restoring contaminated sites, and tackling climate change challenges and resilience. We focus on preserving habitats, water quality, stakeholder engagement and cultural resources, promoting a holistic approach to environmental impact management at every project stage.

Our highly regarded Environmental team in Melbourne is seeking Professional Environmental Scientist/ Engineer with experience with Contaminated land investigations and remediation to support a range of exciting and meaningful projects across the energy, resources, Infrastructure and defence sectors.

**What will a day in this role look like:**

* Delivering fieldwork across ground remediation and contaminated land projects, including site investigations, remediation works, validation sampling and monitoring across the Victoria
* Managing field projects, including supervising contractors and mentoring graduates onsite
* Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality, client-focused outcomes
* Engaging with clients, regulators, and stakeholders to support project delivery
* Contributing to a positive team culture and collaborative, knowledge-sharing environment

  
**Qualifications**

The following qualifications and experience are highly desired, but if you don’t tick all the boxes, you could still be a perfect fit for this role. Please apply, all applications will be considered.

**What are we looking for from you?**

* A degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field, and a valid Australian driver’s licence
* Willingness to undertake regular fieldwork across contaminated land and remediation projects, including site investigations, remediation works and monitoring programs
* Around 2- 5 years experience in ground remediation, including contaminated land assessment, soil and groundwater remediation or related field-based work ideally
* Able to work independently, manage competing priorities and get involved across a wide range of projects while contributing to a supportive, team-focused environment
* Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal – with the ability to translate technical concepts clearly
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to work independently when needed
* A proactive attitude, curiosity to learn, and a commitment to delivering quality work

  
**Additional Information**

**Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?**

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities, additional health or mental health needs, and/or neurodiverse conditions. If you require any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know.

Applications are reviewed as they come in, and the role may close earlier than expected, so if this opportunity sounds like you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Learn more about life at AECOM: LinkedIn, Facebook , Instagram, X, YouTube - explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!
